segments.comment: A debug-mode Samurai carries just under her weight limit, burns nutrition with wizard-mode teleports until Weak costs a point of strength and burdens her, welds a cursed two-handed sword, then forces a prayer that fixes both troubles. eat.c init_uhunger() restores the strength and encumber_msg() reports the lighter load before the sword glows.
